video_title: The Celtics Invaded a Local Sports Bar in Charleston for NFL Sunday

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Mazzulla is empowering Celtics players to coach themselves during practice
quotes.excerpt: the coaches were making us coach ourselves at times during practice
quotes.quote: Last year we saw you guys playing spikeball. This year, Sam Hauser told me the other day that the coaches were making us coach ourselves at times during practice. There is a lot of ownership on us as the players to release different things and see things, talk about it, and work together to find what works and what doesn't work and how we can be most successful for the year. They are doing a great job of putting a lot of pressure on us to figure it out and we are all enjoying it.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics players have shown significant improvement over the summer
quotes.excerpt: it has been great to see the development of everybody
quotes.quote: It has been great to see the development of everybody. We had a great summer and to come back and see how hard people are working, how hard we are playing, and how much they have improved over the summer has been the greatest thing. From top to bottom, there are different ways that people are more comfortable, more sure of themselves, and it has been fun to see.

quotes.speaker: Derrick White
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics' depth and versatility make them difficult to beat
quotes.excerpt: there are so many different ways for us to win
quotes.quote: There are so many different ways for us to win and so many different guys that can step up. The exciting thing is you never really know whose night it is going to be. Obviously, Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown, most nights it is going to be their night, but you never know throughout the whole season whose night it is going to be. We have a roster where you can put anybody out there and we expect them to hold to the standard that we set. We have a lot of faith and confidence in everybody in the roster.
